The local restaurant owner, whose eatery is a must-visit stop in each food tour, has noticed that every week, 5 different food tours make a stop at the restaurant. Each tour brings in an average of 12 tourists. If each tourist spends about $15 on food during their visit, how much total revenue does the restaurant owner make from these food tours in a week? The total revenue is calculated by multiplying the number of tourists (5 tours × 12 tourists = 60 tourists) by the average spending per tourist ($15). 60 × $15 = $900. 

Postscript: The restaurant owner makes $900 in total revenue from food tours each week.
